exposure: method of surgical volume data collection (population-based vs. facility-based)
cohort: The study included 10,001 household members from 1,854 randomly selected households across Sierra Leone.
finding: Population-based data collection identified 4.1 times more surgical procedures than facility-based data, revealing a likely underreporting in facilities and overall surgical volume in Sierra Leone far below global benchmarks.
cross-section timing: Data was collected for surgical procedures performed in the year preceding the interview.
